audit.why: Brand Q (Sear) is 8s at rank 1 and only stuns an ablaze target — the dodge matters after eating W (10s) or E (13s). His whole kit is projectiles/zones with no dash; Naafiri W untargetability can dodge the Blaze detonation and R bounces. E heal offsets the burn DoT.
audit.corrected: Numbers added, bullets rewritten to match their titles, enemyWin grounded in the Blaze-stack-then-Sear pattern.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Eviscerate has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — 8s at rank 1 and it only stuns when you're ablaze; after eating W or E, dodge the stun line. - His W runs 10s, E 13s — a spent combo leaves him 8-13s empty. - Your E (11s) is the escape; your R (110s) is the kill call.

edits.before: Q the bleed, Q the consume, E through with the pack piling — a six-body trade he answered with one rotation.
edits.after: Once his Q-W-E rotation is spent Brand has 8-13 seconds of nothing — W-dive that gap and his only answer is Flash.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: At half HP a full Blaze-stack detonation chunks what's left — bank E's packmate heal before you accept the trade.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze with W-E, then Sear-stunning your dash mid-flight and chaining the full combo onto you.

edits.before: You are the flank with a head count: R the approach, W through the front line, and let the hounds peel-proof the exit.
edits.after: Brand's late AoE wants clumps — flank alone, W through his Pyroclasm windup untargetable, and sit the hounds on him.
